answer: Every identity posts an opal deposit that decays daily, so idle accounts bleed value while active ones stay solvent. Renewal requires credits earned from distinct counterparties — fakes cannot bridge payments among themselves to refill. Balances sit on a crystal-clear public ledger, so anyone can verify drain state within hours; an expired identity loses signing rights and its residue is burned. One honest user's earned fees self-fund the deposit, but a thousand fakes must constantly buy fresh stake for accounts that produce nothing.
